name: Callback fluency
prompt: Write an on-init script that triggers a sine wave note C4 for 500ms when MIDI CC64 is received with value above 0.5.
rubric: Engine.playNote or Synth.playNote used (not invented API)
timer via Engine.createTimerObject or Synth.startTimer (not setTimeout, not invented createTimer)
no stock-JS tokens (let, =>, async, console.log, document., backticks, .forEach, for...of)

name: Variable and syntax anchor
prompt: Create an array of 16 step values, all initialized to 0.5. Then loop over them and print each index and value to the console.
rubric: reg i or const var arr (HISE style, not stock let)
explicit for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) loop (not .forEach / .map / for...of)

name: Component and child synth lookup
prompt: Given a knob called 'Gain' on the interface, write code that reads its value and sets the gain of a child synth called 'MainSynth' to that value.
rubric: no C++ syntax (no pointers, no nullptr, no ->)

name: LAF composition for toggle button
prompt: Create a local look-and-feel for a toggle button that draws the button area in dark grey when off, bright green when on, with white centered text showing obj.text.
rubric: g.setColour with hex 0xFF... or Colours.* constant
g.drawAlignedText(obj.text, obj.area, "centred") with 'centred' spelling and .setLocalLookAndFeel attaches the LAF

name: Sampler keys colouring (corpus probe)
prompt: Iterate over MIDI notes 36 to 96 and colour the keys of the on-screen keyboard blue for every note that is mapped in a sampler called 'Sampler1'.

name: Broadcaster pattern
prompt: Create a broadcaster that listens to all knob value changes on the interface and prints each knob's id and new value to the console.
rubric: attachToComponentValue or attachTo* method on broadcaster
callback signature function(index, component, value) with 3 args

name: Panel paint routine
prompt: Create a panel that draws a horizontal progress bar filling left to right, showing the current value (0 to 1) of a knob called "Progress". The bar should update visually when the knob changes.
rubric: panel.setPaintRoutine(function(g) {...}) (not registerFunction which is for LAF)

name: Timer with realtime state
prompt: Write a 60 BPM metronome that prints an incrementing beat counter to the console every beat. Add a button "Start" that toggles the metronome on and off.
rubric: reg counter (not var, for realtime persistence)
onTimer global callback (not named handler, not arrow)
Engine.stopTimer() or Synth.stopTimer() on button off

name: File I/O JSON
prompt: Save an array of integers to a JSON file in the AudioFiles project folder called "settings.json", then read it back into a new variable and print it.
rubric: no invented fs.writeFile / new File(path) / Node.js API

name: User preset load hook
prompt: Register a callback that runs whenever a user preset is loaded. The callback should inspect the loaded preset data for a "version" field and print a warning if the version is below 2.0.
rubric: access preset data via callback arg or Engine.getUserPresetData()
version comparison logic on nested property

name: Global timer with reg state
prompt: Write a script that counts how many MIDI notes have been played, prints the count every 2 seconds, and resets the count each time it prints.
rubric: reg counter (not var — must persist across realtime callbacks)
Engine.startTimer(2000) or Synth.startTimer(2000) with correct ms
onTimer global callback prints and resets
no invented Engine.createMetronome or timer-object API

name: Panel mouse callback
prompt: Create a panel that changes its background colour between red and blue each time the user clicks on it.
rubric: event.clicked or event.mouseDown to detect click
panel.data used for toggle state (not closure var)

name: Combobox selection callback
prompt: Create a combobox with 4 filter type options (LowPass, HighPass, BandPass, Notch). When the user selects one, set the filter type of a child effect called "Filter1".

name: Key press callback on image
prompt: Add an image component "KeyImage". When the user focuses it and presses the space bar, print "Space pressed" to the console. Use the image's key press callback.
rubric: event.character == " " or event.keyCode check for space

name: Broadcaster attached to multiple knobs
prompt: Have a single callback fire whenever any of three knobs (Gain, Pan, Mix) changes, printing which knob changed and the new value. Use a broadcaster, not three separate callbacks.
rubric: attachToComponentValue([knobs]) or attachTo* with component list
callback signature function(index, component, value) with 3 args
no manual setControlCallback on each knob

name: Animated panel with self-timer
prompt: Create a panel that displays a horizontal VU meter showing Math.random() as the level. The meter should animate smoothly, updating at 30fps.

name: Vector rotary knob with path indicator
prompt: Create a local look-and-feel for a rotary knob. Draw a dark-grey filled circle as background, a green arc indicator sweeping from the 7 o'clock position to 5 o'clock filled proportionally to obj.valueNormalized, and a small white tick line pointing in the current angle direction.
rubric: Content.createPath() to build path object (not new Path() C++ style, not SVG-d-string)
path method chain: startNewSubPath / lineTo / quadraticTo / addArc / closeSubPath on the Path
angle math via obj.valueNormalized with Math.PI (sweep uses normalized 0..1 scaled across the arc span)
g.fillPath(path, area) or g.drawPath(path, area, thickness) with area-array arg (not 4 separate x/y/w/h args)

name: Preset-load validation callback
prompt: Register a callback that fires after a user preset loads. Check that the preset contains valid data for a "filterCutoff" parameter (between 20 and 20000). If not, print a warning and reset it to 1000.
rubric: write-back via setAttribute to restore default 1000

name: Audio file loaded callback
prompt: Create an AudioSampleBufferComponent. When the user drops a new audio file onto it, print the file's sample rate and length in seconds to the console.
rubric: audioFile.getNumSamples() and division by sampleRate for length

name: Shared callback with indexOf
prompt: Register one shared inline function that handles value changes for 8 filter-cutoff knobs named "Freq0" through "Freq7". The callback should use indexOf to figure out which knob changed and set the cutoff of the matching filter "Filter0"..."Filter7".
rubric: array of knobs built via loop (const var knobs = []; for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) knobs.push(Content.getComponent("Freq" + i)))
local index = knobs.indexOf(component) pattern from transcripts
